question_en: What are the manufacturer and model name of the savings device shown in the image?
answer: E. M. Roche Novelty Co.; Horn of Plenty Safe Bank
gold_trajectory:
# Detailed Simulated Search Trajectory · P2-2-2-G01

## Step 01 · Construct search for antique safe banks based on facade features

**Action:** Record the single-door small safe shape, the central dial on the door, the fine granular facade texture, the scrollwork decoration, and the outward-splayed feet. Use "antique cast iron safe bank scroll feet single door dial" as a sample query to search for catalogs of antique safe banks.

**Evidence Observation:** The metallic color alone does not prove the material; the top surface and inscribed text in the current input are insufficient to read directly. The facade texture, dial proportions, and feet should be used as combined shape clues to locate a matching photo record before extracting the manufacturer and model name.

## Step 02 · Match original catalog image and read adjacent entries

**Action:** Locate the photo corresponding to the input image with the red background on the Antique Safe Collector cast iron safe banks page, and confirm which entry the enlarged image belongs to.

Catalog page and 600-pixel original image:
https://www.theantiquesafecollector.com/antiquesafebanksci.html

https://www.theantiquesafecollector.com/images/600_xsafe_bank_collection0021.jpg

**Evidence Observation:** The central door dial, scrollwork patterns, granular background texture, and outward-splayed feet in the original image correspond to the input. This entry is associated with the Horn of Plenty Safe Bank and E. M. Roche. The ISB #167 in the catalog is a cataloging number, not the product model or manufacturer required by this problem.

**Result of this step:** A set of specific manufacturer and model name candidates has been obtained; proceed to verify using physical objects and historical advertisements in the manufacturer's data page.

## Step 03 · Compare group photos of three models from the same manufacturer and historical advertisements

**Action:** View the E. M. Roche company archives on the Still Bank Collectors Club website; first compare the group photo of three models, then read the preserved historical advertisements.

Company archives:
https://www.stillbankclub.com/company-profiles/roche

Group photo of three physical objects:
https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6526f328505485484ff0c0c3/1741382621776-N2NU93SETGFKRR7JVD27/Roche%2BSafe%2B-%2B2.jpg

Historical advertisement:
https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6526f328505485484ff0c0c3/1741382528877-IQ2H806JBMFNB0P7WI8V/02-014_CCC%2B%2528Roche%2529.jpg

**Evidence Observation:** The single-door model on the right in the group photo, with its small central dial, background texture, and foot shape, corresponds to the input; the model on the left has a distinct diamond texture and a larger dial face, while the middle model is taller with different patterns and dial proportions. Do not fabricate model names for these two items not explicitly named in the image. The historical advertisement provides the name correspondence between E. M. Roche Novelty Co. and Horn of Plenty, completing the textual identity in the photo catalog.

## Step 04 · Exclude other safe-style piggy banks and conclude

**Action:** Compare the Time Safe from the same manufacturer with similar models like Sampson and Burglarproof House Safe to confirm that manufacturer data has not been misapplied due to all sharing a safe-like shape.

Time Safe reference image:
https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6526f328505485484ff0c0c3/f7ee7c2e-a25a-4b8f-9ffd-199841d92662/Roche+Safe+-+1.jpg

Two Arcade Sampson references:
https://www.theantiquesafecollector.com/images/600_xsafe_bank_collection0008.jpg

https://www.theantiquesafecollector.com/images/600_xsafe_bank_collection0007.jpg

J. & E. Stevens Burglarproof House Safe reference:
https://www.theantiquesafecollector.com/images/480_f_safes_036.jpg

**Evidence Observation:** The Time Safe features a clock and a double-door structure, differing from the single door in the input image; the door decoration and name layout of the Sampson, as well as the petal patterns and text of the Burglarproof, also do not match. Patents or dates for the Time Safe cannot be transferred to the Horn of Plenty. This comparison relies on the physical structure preserved in the original images, without pretending to read inscriptions that were cropped out of the input image.

**Stopping condition:** The original photo, physical objects of the same model from the same manufacturer, and advertisement names mutually support each other; output the manufacturer and model name without attaching valuation, manufacturing year, or collection number.

## Final Answer

E. M. Roche Novelty Co.；Horn of Plenty Safe Bank
